name: Seidr (Oracle Mystery)
body:
If you are using the oracle class in your games, you can use this mystery as written. If you are instead (or also) using the Priestess core class, you can use these Revelations to replace the standard priestess abilities gained at 2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th level.

Others may call you a matchmaker, fortune teller, oracle, or seer. In Greece, you may be known as a mantis. Regardless of your title, you can discern the course of fate and bring about change by weaving new events into being when necessary. With this magic, you can confer blessings or curses upon another’s future. Seidr uses divination magic to seek out the hidden, bring good luck, change the future, and influence destiny.

Class Skills: An oracle with the seidr mystery adds Knowledge (Nature), Perception, Use Magic Device, and one additional skill of her choice to her list of class skills.

Bonus Spells: divine favor (2nd), anticipate thoughts (4th), arcane sight (6th), divination (8th), battlemind link (10th), truespeak (12th), jolting portent (14th), spellcrash, greater (16th), wish (18th)

Revelations: An oracle with the seidr mystery can choose from any of the following revelations.

Destiny Magic: You know more magical ways to alter destiny than most. When you select this revelation, choose Boon & Bane or Twisted Destiny. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed. Once per day, as a swift action, you can cast a spell from your selected list as a spell-like ability. The spell you cast doesn’t need to be the same each time you use this ability.

Boon & Bane: crushing despair, good hope, prayer

Twisted Destiny: confusion, friend to foe, prediction of failure You must be at least 15th level to select this revelation.

Fated (Su)

Select one type of saving throw—Fortitude, Reflex, or Will. Henceforth, you add your Charisma modifier as a circumstance bonus to all saving throws of the selected type. This choice is permanent and can’t be changed. At 11th level, you exude an aura of fate in a 5-foot radius. All allies within this radius gain 1/2 your bonus (round down, minimum 1) on the same type of saving throw.

Harrowing Deck (Ex)

You use your magic to create a harrowing deck attuned to your fate—it doesn’t function for anyone but you. The deck has four cards—books, cups, flowers, and deer.

Each day at dawn, you randomly draw (roll 1d4) a card from the deck which influences your fate for the next 24 hours. If your deck is destroyed, you can spend 1 hour creating a new one.

Books: For 24 hours, you gain a +2 bonus to your Intelligence score and you can make all Knowledge checks untrained.
Cups: For 24 hours, you do not need to eat or drink. Additionally, anytime you receive healing, roll a 1d8 and add that number to the amount of hit points you recover.
Flowers: For 24 hours, you gain a +2 bonus to your Wisdom score, and you gain scent (Ex) with a range of 60 feet.
Deer: For 24 hours, you gain a +2 bonus to your Dexterity score. At 7th level you gain evasion.
Kingmaker (Sp)

Your touch has the power to turn commoners into kings. You can cast heroism, greater as a spell-like ability once per day. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Mantle of Triumph (Su)

As a standard action, you call upon your deity to wrap you in a mantle that destines you to overcome adversity.

Your deity envelopes you in an invisible mantle, granting you DR1/-. At 7th level, and every four levels thereafter, this DR increases by +1. Your deity can protect you for 10 minutes per day per oracle level you possess. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 10-minute increments.

Natural Divination (Ex)

You gain the natural divination revelation of the oracle’s nature mystery.

Obscure Sight (Su)

As a standard action, select one creature within 60 feet. The creature must make a Fortitude saving throw (DC 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier).

On a failed save, the creature is blinded for 1 round for every three oracle levels you possess.

On a successful save, the creature’s eyes are covered over in a milky film, imposing a 20% miss chance on all of its attack rolls for the duration instead. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 7th and 14th level. You must be at least 3rd level to select this revelation.

Preemptive Strike (Su)

When a creature within 30 feet of you is about to cast a spell or make an attack, you can use an immediate action to hurl a ball of fate-energy at it. Make a ranged touch attack. If the attack is successful, the creature loses the spell or drops the weapon at its feet. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time per day at 15th and 19th level. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Secrets Revealed (Ex)

Each day at dawn, you can roll 1d4. For the next 24 hours, you gain a sacred (or profane if you’re evil) bonus equal to your roll on all Perception and Sense Motive checks.

Soul-Sight (Su)

As an action, you can look into another’s soul to automatically determine its alignment. Alternatively, you can use this ability as a swift or an immediate action to determine if a single statement a creature just made is true or false. You can use this ability 3 times per day. You gain one additional use per day at 11th and 14th level. You must be at least 7th level to select this revelation.

Sultry Song/Sonnet (Su)

You gain the bard’s Bardic Performance (fascinate) ability using an auditory (song or oratory) component. Using this ability follows all the same rules as beginning and maintaining a bardic performance. You can use this ability for a number of rounds per day equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier, plus 1 additional round at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th levels.

Final Revelation: Upon reaching 20th level, you can weave the events of the past, present, and future together, redefining your reality. Once per turn, when you miss with an attack roll, you can roll an additional 1d6 and add the results to your roll, potentially turning the failure into a success. Additionally, once per day, when you take damage from a melee or ranged weapon attack, you can use an immediate action to instantly negate the attack as though it missed you altogether.

Amazons vs Valkyries: Cult of Freyja, © 2023, Bloodstone Press; Author P. C. Graves and Beth Jones
